<MethodEndpoint

  context={"endpoint"}
>
  
</MethodEndpoint>



Fetches full metadata from TMDb and creates the movie record in a
single transaction. Director, actors, and genres are found or created
automatically — no duplicates.

Returns `409 Conflict` (with the existing movie body) if a movie with
that `tmdb_id` is already in the database.
